EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for responding to the call.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Blood Program Leader],
Thank you for being a part of the American Red Cross Battle of the Badges program. Together we share a mission of helping to save lives and we appreciate the opportunity to partner with [Contact Organization].
You can take pride in knowing that your partnership with us makes a positive impact on your local community — and those across the country. Families and communities depend on the Red Cross in times of need; and we depend on the support of partners, like you, to help fulfill the mission of saving lives.
Your Heroes Saving Lives blood drive took place on [Date] and had a goal of [Units]. You collected a total of [xx] units, each of which can impact more than one life.
We rely on blood drive partnerships throughout the year. Thank you for offering this opportunity to your group to help ensure a safe national blood supply. We appreciate you and hope we can partner again in the future.
Sincerely,
[Signature]
